name: Agamand Family Dagger
summary: In northern Tirisfal, the Agamand Family Dagger rests among the weapons in the family crypt. Coleman Farthing seeks it and the family’s other arms to strip his former masters of their legacy and honor.

sections.title: A Legacy in the Crypt
sections.body: Before the Third War, the Agamand family held vast estates and grain mills in the rolling meadows of northern Tirisfal Glades. The Scourge destroyed their power, but their weapons endured in the family crypt north of Agamand Mills. Restless undead members of the household and mindless servants of the Lich King guard the dagger. It recalls the martial heritage and standing the family once held above its servants and tenants.

sections.title: A Spiteful Requisition
sections.body: Coleman Farthing resides at Brill, but he once died in the Agamands’ service. He blames the family for his death, and the dagger means resentment to him, not noble lineage. Farthing sends adventurers into the Agamand Family Crypt for the dagger, sword, axe, and mace. By taking these arms from the tomb, he seeks to rob the Scourge patriarchs of their last dignity and extinguish the Agamand name.

faq.q: What is the Agamand Family Dagger?
faq.answer: The wealthy Agamand family of Tirisfal Glades owned this ancestral weapon. It was laid with the family’s other arms in their crypt, now under Scourge control.

faq.q: Where is the Agamand Family Dagger found?
faq.answer: The dagger rests on an Agamand Weapon Rack inside the Agamand Family Crypt, at the northern end of Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Coleman Farthing want this dagger?
aliases: why does farthing want the dagger
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing served the Agamands in life and blames them for his death. He wants the dagger and the other heirlooms to strip his former masters of their honor and finish their ruin.

faq.q: Who are the other weapons in this heirloom set?
aliases: what else is in the crypt
faq.answer: The set also includes the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Axe, and the Agamand Family Mace. All lie among weapon racks in the family crypt.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know the bitter divide between the Forsaken who survived in Lordaeron and their former masters, now bound to mindless service in the Scourge.
As a Rogue, you know how slipping past risen dead to take blades from the crypt’s weapon racks can turn burglary into cold vengeance.
